prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Status Feed: Add a live rendering activity feed component on the waiting screen to inform users of pet generation progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "rounded", "label": "Generating Desktop Pet Assets"}]}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Journey Carousel Layout: Redesign the story intro screen to use a carousel layout highlighting companion desktop features prior to path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Discover Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Explore interactive pet features that live directly on your screen while you work and play."}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Selection Account Auth Flow: Move sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and customization steps right before desktop launch waiting.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Stage Spotlight Layout: Redesign the friend picker screen with a spotlight layout highlighting pet personalities and traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Select the personality and visual style of your companion."}}
4: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Activity Timer Stream: Include a countdown timer and active tips delay display on the home waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "Preparing desktop shaders and interaction scripts..."}}
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Launch View: Redesign the final home intro screen using a spotlight layout showing essential desktop tray and visibility controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Use the system tray icon or keyboard shortcuts to command, hide, or talk to your pet anytime."}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Stage Card Grid View: Reconfigure the choose_path screen into a stage layout with distinct visual option cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Select Your Journey Path", "body": "Choose how you want to experience your companion on your desktop."}}
7: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Stage Layout Overhaul: Change the photo upload screen layout to split view to clearly display pet reference images side-by-side with recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "Provide clear photos for accurate desktop pet 3D generation."}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Keybindings Copy Focus: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explicitly explain pet tray controls and visibility shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Master Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Click the system tray pet icon to bring up controls, toggle visibility, or start conversation."}}
9: [home, new_flow] Desktop Generation Progress Notification Stream: Enable desktop arrival notifications and progress tracking on the waiting screen to keep users informed during long setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Assembling Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is being configured and placed on your desktop background."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding rendering progress indicators to the waiting screen is allowed and complies with all rules.
Redesigning the story screen with a carousel layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Reordering sign-in to after adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4 and retains all required steps.
Redesigning the friend picker layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Time estimates and progress hints during a real wait are allowed on the waiting screen.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Updating the layout and copy of the choose path screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Changing the photo upload screen layout to a split view is allowed inside onboarding.
Updating home intro copy regarding desktop tray controls is allowed inside onboarding.
Enabling status notifications and progress tracking on the waiting screen is allowed.
